Hi Sarah 

Great to meet today. Quick recap and proposed next steps to get the POC for Stellar Commerce onto a fast timeline: 

1) Success criteria (attached):
   - Integration: Redwood API up for search & chat use cases against a 10K SKU subset; sample queries return within 200ms median.
   - Quality: Precision on top-3 rerank >= 85% vs. your labeled eval set.
   - Cost/throughput: sustain 50 qps for baseline test window.

2) Evaluation plan (attached & above):
   - Week 0: access & network allowlist, sample data ingest (you)
   - Week 1: integration + smoke tests (Redwood + Stellar)
   - Week 2: load tests + quality evals (joint)
   - Week 3: review & decision window

3) Ownership & timelines:
   - Stellar: provide sample dataset, test users, and network contact (NetOps) 

- owner: Sarah / Ethan
   - Redwood: provide sandbox credentials, integration docs, load-test plan 

- owner: Priyom (SE)
   - PM contact: Marissa (Redwood) for weekly syncs

4) Risks noted (initial):
   - Potential latency >200ms at peak concurrency.
   - Network allowlisting could delay kickoff if firewall changes are required.

Attachments: POC_success_criteria.xlsx, POC_risk_tracker.csv

Can you confirm the success criteria and that Ethan will be the evaluation lead? We’ve tentatively scheduled a kickoff for Tue 20 Jul at 10am PT — let us know if that works.

Thanks,

Hi all 

Adding the technical plan and a quick note on the biggest risk we saw in the call: latency at concurrency. Summary:

- Proposed technical steps:
  * Redwood sandbox with API key + sample dataset ingestion (Day 0-1)
  * Integration tests and smoke (Day 2-4)
  * Load test (Day 5-7) using our bench (INF-4482) to validate 50 qps baseline and track p50/p95 latencies
  * Quality evals using your labeled set (Day 7-10)

- Risk/impact:
  * Risk: model inference latency could exceed your 200ms median SLO at peak; this mostly shows up at >30 concurrent sessions without dedicated pooling.
  * Mitigation: recommend Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) for the load test + enable prefix/KV caching. If dedicated isn’t available for the trial, we can run a focused async load test window with throttled concurrency and provide tuned batching configs.
  * Escalation path: open INF-4482 for infra work; if the latency persists during the trial we escalate to Platform Eng (cc: Michael).

I attached the load-test-plan.pdf. I’ll own the sandbox config and test run.

- Action items:
  1) Sarah/Ethan: confirm allowlist constraints (IPs vs. domain egress)
  2) Marissa: confirm whether we can provision a short-lived dedicated pool for the test or if we run the throttled approach

Thanks 
Priyom
